key_findings.finding: 44/50 unambiguous nonself weak targets recovered; 42/43 committed nonself vote targets and 14/19 ordinary-accusation targets present in sus. Six misses are genuine positive-coverage gaps, not over-defensive role rejection. Category hits can come from any same-target weak phrase.

Misses cluster in nominal suspicion (Suspicion points to / Suspicions on), adjectival lists (suspicious players like), possessive behavior and an elliptical vote switch. Current weak-target regex recognizes direct PlayerN is suspicious / vote PlayerN / suspect PlayerN. All six explicit literal rewrites succeed without changing the parser.

Sample has no unambiguous own seer claim or explicit personal checked verdict, despite frequent references to Seer info. A parser cannot recover an unstated result; do not interpret lack of claims as evidence that claim detection failed.

Eight of 51 committed vote texts target the broadcasting speaker in the canonical source. They are intentionally removed by read_chat sender filtering; study model seat/intent wording separately rather than treating this as parser loss.

Production policy gives ordinary sus zero generic score weight for villager/seer and uses it for wolf crowd following; trusted seer calls are a separate path. Even a better weak parser need not improve every transmit or win metric.

No parser/production/tests/corpus edits. Preserve held-out freeze. Future tuning should use these as development guards and require a fresh independent evaluation, not reuse the frozen 331 as new validation.

sources.seat_provenance: scenario.llm_seats, cross-checked against llm_seats[*].seat; controlled candidate seat excluded
sources.broadcast_provenance: synthetic_trace.messages[*], sender in LLM seats, visibility=broadcast, no recipients, nonempty content
sources.fallback_note: Official local LLM message fallback terminates discussion; it does not synthesize a broadcast. Texts are messages actually emitted, after SDK word/character normalization.

sampling.algorithm: All readable game-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9].json in completed v3 only; retain scenario.llm_seats broadcasts; exact UTF-8 text SHA256 dedup across profiles, games and cache copies; sort ascending text_sha256, take first min(80,N). No parser output or hidden role participates.
sampling.sample_list_hash_definition: SHA256(UTF8 JSON of ordered [sample_id,text_sha256] pairs, separators=(comma,colon))
sampling.canonical_source_policy: Earliest lexicographically sorted game file and message index for each text; all duplicate refs retained for traceability but never counted as independent samples.

freeze.hash_definition: SHA256(UTF8 JSON of ordered [{sample_id,text_sha256,annotation}], sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon))
freeze.method: Single analyst independently labelled all 80 texts from frozen hash sample. Parser signature/field comments were read, but no read_chat outputs were generated or consulted. No actual hidden role, winner, action trace, observation or request prompt was used as semantic truth.

annotation_protocol.own_seer_claim: Speaker asserts own seer identity or own completed investigation carrying a bound verdict, regardless of truth/hidden role. A wolf falsely claiming seer would still be a positive claim.
annotation_protocol.checked_result: Only a completed personal check with a named target and explicit wolf/clear verdict; mentions of Seer info, confirmation, own observations or future investigation requests are insufficient.
annotation_protocol.ordinary_accusation: Named or unambiguously referred-to weak suspicion/lying/shady behavior, not a certain wolf or checked result.
annotation_protocol.vote_intent: Committed/endorsed elimination vs tentative/conditional; support/side/focus/consensus without clear elimination direction is ambiguous.
annotation_protocol.ambiguity: Annotations frozen before comparison; per-target optional fields excluded from assertive precision and from required recall. No ambiguous phrase promoted to hard gold after observing parser.
annotation_protocol.precision_rule: Compare required/excluded target sets after sender-self filtering; preserve the annotation itself unchanged. Report null precision/recall when denominator is zero.

comparison_run.calls: read_chat(text, sender=source_sender, names=None), once for each unique text/sender pair
comparison_run.method: Canonical sender is first lexicographic game occurrence; additional unique sender contexts stored, not independent sample units. Remove sender from target comparison per read_chat API contract. Uncertain target/field pairs are excluded, not scored as hard negatives or positives.

limits: This is an 80-unique-text deterministic hash sample from one completed local synthetic run, NOT representative platform accuracy or an independent game outcome experiment. Exact dedup changes the frequency distribution; paraphrases and scenarios still correlate.

All 120 candidate-profile game files were eligible without selecting winners, roles, cleanliness or parser successes. Exact text dedup collapses candidate/cache copies into one annotation unit. No requests/cache raw files were needed.

0 unambiguous own seer claims and 0 explicit own checked-wolf/clear results in this sample: natural-message claim and strong-verdict recall are unidentifiable, NOT 100%. Clear ambiguity v3-16 and attributed clear v3-50 are deliberately not hard gold.

Quoted claims/verdicts do not occur in the sample. The nine negation cues mostly concern Seer silence, not negated wolf assertions. This is not fresh evidence that adversarial quote/negation guards are complete.

ChatFacts.sus merges vote appeals and ordinary suspicion. A recovered target does not prove that a vote commitment (especially pronoun votes) was separately understood. Category tallies overlap and are not additive.

Eight canonical speakers publicly said they would vote for their own seat. The parser intentionally discards self targets, so these are not scored as parser false negatives. We did not inspect the actual subsequent action or hidden role to explain them.

Single human-style analyst, not two independent annotators. Directionally ambiguous support/focus/consensus and conditional votes are optional/excluded, not retrospectively hardened to fit parser results.

Reported-clear attribution is a contract question: v3-50 produces clears=[3], claim=false. Depending on intended downstream meaning this can be endorsed fact or copied report; its assertive precision is excluded, not falsely certified.
Only current state.read_chat was evaluated. Policy consumption, transport/scheduling, actual voting and wins were not replayed, so no causal win-rate or transmit-failure attribution is warranted.

No v2 used: v3 supplied more than 80 unique broadcasts. No currently running v4 files, requests or held-out-331 results were opened. Explicit synthetic clarifiers are separate post-audit guard proposals, not additional sampled model messages.

Source whole-game JSON was decoded only to select public LLM broadcasts/provenance; hidden roles, decisions, private observations, private chat content, prompts and credentials were not exported or used as semantic truth.

io.metadata_filename_correction: Initial broad glob included game-provider-start.json metadata. Before annotation the glob was restricted to four digits; no sampled text/hash changed, and all 120 real game records were readable and had required fields.
